children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may test a support at 4,622 ringgit per metric ton, a break below which could open the way toward the 4,567-4,588 ringgit range.

The nature of the current fall remains unclear. It might be the third leg of a correction from 4,756 ringgit, or a continuation of the downtrend from 5,049 ringit, due to the completion of the bounce from 4,501 ringgit.

Resistance is at 4,696 ringgit, a break above which may lead to a gain into the 4,732-4,766 ringgit range. On the daily chart, the market again failed to break a resistance at 4,771 ringgit, the 50% retracement on the downtrend from 5,050 ringgit.
The failure indicates either an exhaustion or a completion of the bounce. The market may first retrace into the 4,573-4,623 ringgit range.
A further development of the chart is needed to evaluate the trending signals.
